title: Upper and lower bounds for the critical point of the three-dimensional Ising model: manuscript sources and verification programs
description: Manuscript sources, certificate programs, input tables and output logs for the computer-assisted proof of the bounds 1.541630483 < e^{2K_c} < 1.582145851 on the critical point of the nearest-neighbour Ising ferromagnet on Z^3.
